fusions.name: Closing Swarm
fusions.desc: Sends a swarm that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Penned Pickings
fusions.desc: The swarm deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 12% for each affliction already on the target (max 48%).

fusions.name: Living Bars
fusions.desc: Raises a line of locked locusts 5 tiles long for 6 seconds. Anything that crosses it is left [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Feeding Time
fusions.desc: When you put a condition on an enemy, you heal for 20% of the damage you deal for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
